targets.summary: The new stable-IValue functions should move from the AOTI shim to the non-AOTI torch/csrc/shim_common.cpp and drop the aoti_ prefix.
targets.evidence: The comment sits at the top of the file (line 1, `#include <ATen/native/quantized/cpu/qlinear.h>`) and is general, so it applies to the file-level request: move the stable-IValue functions out of the AOTI shim and drop the `aoti_` prefix. The includes at the top are unchanged. The diff removes `aoti_torch_new_stable_ivalue` and `aoti_torch_delete_stable_ivalue` from torch/csrc/inductor/aoti_torch/shim_common.cpp. The error state also moves to the shared `torch::csrc::shim::details::get_torch_exception_what()`/`set_torch_exception_what()`, which suggests the functions were moved to the non-AOTI torch/csrc/shim_common.cpp. I can only see this file's diff, so I can't confirm the new unprefixed names directly.
